name: Base Tite vs 11P Zone Read
personnel: Peso Nickel (4 DL + 2 LB + Hybrid DB-LB)

summary.motive: Eliminate every interior gap with the 4i-0-4i box so a spread-run play must bounce to the perimeter, where the walked-down peso waits as the unblockable extra defender.
summary.keyDefender: PESO nickel — the DB-LB hybrid whose walk-down turns a blocked-even run picture into a plus-one box
summary.whyItWorks: Zone read rules force the offense to leave a 4i unblocked, but the tite spacing means the read key squeezes instead of chasing, and the pulling quarterback’s lane is owned by a defender the run game cannot account for.
summary.failureMode: Pitch or perimeter constraint plays: once the box eats the interior, offenses flip to speed option and quick throws at the vacated nickel flat.

beats.title: 1. The Tite Box Picture
beats.text: Two 4i techniques sit on the guards’ outside shoulders with a head-up nose between them — both B-gaps are doubled before the snap. The apex linebackers split the tackle-to-#2 lines while the peso nickel hovers ready to walk down.

beats.title: 2. Zone Flow Meets Two Squeezing 4is
beats.text: As the line reaches right, both 4is attack inside shoulders rather than chasing flow. Neither guard can reach a defender who refuses to be widened, so the reach blocks are already failing at the second step.

beats.title: 3. Nose Anchors, Peso Becomes the Plus-One
beats.text: The nose splits the center-guard double team while the walked-down peso defeats the tight end’s arc. The offense left the 4i unblocked expecting numbers; the nickel walking down erases that math.

beats.title: 4. The Pulled Ball Runs Into the Nickel
beats.text: The quarterback pulls on the squeeze exactly as coached, but his keep lane now belongs to the peso with WILL scraping behind. The read was honest — the front simply had an extra hat the offense could not block.

relations.tell: Both interior defenders aligned INSIDE the tackles (4i shades) rather than head-up or wide — the pure tite picture has no defender in either C-gap pre-snap.
